title: The Exorcist (franchise) — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. All of these installments focus on fictional accounts of people possessed by Pazuzu, the main antagonist of the series, and the efforts of religious authorities to counter this possession. The films have grossed over $661 million at the worldwide box office and the novel has sold over 13 million copies. 20th Century Fox Television developed a 2016 television series as a continuation of the 1973 film, to generally positive reviews.

The nihilist does not deny The Exorcist (franchise) — he only refuses to flatter it. Linda Blair makes a cameo appearance as her iconic character, Regan MacNeil. The film's terrible reception lead the studio to cancel the remainder of Green's planned trilogy.
